keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Dan Burn (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Lewis Hall (Newcastle United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Newcastle United 0, Everton 0.
Second Half begins Newcastle United 0, Everton 0.
Goal! Newcastle United 0, Everton 1. Thierno Barry (Everton) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal following a set piece situation.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Delay in match because of an injury Fabian Schär (Newcastle United).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Tyrique George (Everton) is shown the yellow card.
Delay in match because of an injury James Garner (Everton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Yoane Wissa replaces Joe Willock.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Sean Steur replaces Nico González.
Delay in match because of an injury Thierno Barry (Everton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Ramsey replaces Joelinton.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Jacob Murphy replaces Anthony Elanga.
Substitution, Everton. Brennan Johnson replaces Thierno Barry.
Substitution, Everton. Michael Keane replaces Jarrad Branthwaite.
Substitution, Newcastle United. Bazoumana Touré replaces Amar Dedic.
Substitution, Everton. Hayden Hackney replaces Tyrique George.
Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second yellow card to Jacob Ramsey (Newcastle United) for a bad foul.
Brennan Johnson (Everton) is shown the yellow card.
Fabian Schär (Newcastle United) is shown the yellow card.
Second Half ends, Newcastle United 0, Everton 1.
